summary: Frontend-only verification of 6-feature NeuroVue batch (asymmetric layout, vertical colorbars, clip plane, reset-to-MNI, real Benson atlas, dual-threshold + mask-zero). 11/13 features PASS with strong visual evidence. 2 issues found: (a) click-to-edit threshold values don't commit on Enter, (b) mask-zero toggle is shown for unsigned data when it should be hidden.

ui_bugs.issue: Click-to-edit threshold value does not commit. Editing opens, typed value ('90') is captured by the input (verified via input.input_value()), Enter triggers commit() which calls onCommit(90), but the parent cal_max state remains at 179.91 (no UI update). Same for low threshold (typed 150, no change). Direct slider drag may still work but text edit path is broken.
ui_bugs.repro: 1) Toggle Polar Angle ON. 2) Click hi threshold value '179.91'. 3) Type '90' and press Enter. 4) Observe value reverts to 179.91 instead of moving to 90 (and slider thumb does not move). Likely cause: handleHiText calls onCalRangeChange with (sortedLo, v)=(0,90). The Dashboard handler may be clamping back to cal_max from niivue or there is a stale closure on sortedLo/sortedHi when commit fires.

ui_bugs.issue: MASK ZERO VOXELS toggle is rendered for the Polar Angle layer (data range 0..180, NOT signed). Per agent_to_agent_context_note this should only appear when global_min<0 && global_max>0. The isSigned prop is being passed as true for unsigned overlays — likely Dashboard.jsx passes isSigned without checking sign of overlayMeta.globalMin.
ui_bugs.repro: Toggle Polar Angle ON. Expand its panel. 'MASK ZERO VOXELS' label + toggle is visible. Expected: hidden (since polar angle min=0).

tests_executed.real_benson_atlas_anatomical_localizatio: PASS — VISUAL EVIDENCE: polar angle, eccentricity, visual_areas overlays all localize to the posterior occipital cortex (back of brain). 3D render clearly shows visual cortex overlays on the occipital pole. Axial slice shows colored overlay constrained to bilateral occipital gyri. This is real fsaverage→MNI projection, NOT the previous synthetic geometric pattern. Polar 0-180 confirmed, eccentricity 0-90 confirmed.

action_items: Fix click-to-edit threshold commit (HIGH): When user types a value in [data-testid=threshold-hi-<id>-input] / [data-testid=threshold-lo-<id>-input] and presses Enter, the value should propagate to cal_max/cal_min and the slider thumb should move. Currently commit fires but state does not update visibly. Investigate Dashboard.jsx handleCalRangeChange — may be re-clamping to a stale global cal range, or the parent is using a stale ref to overlayMeta. Verify by adding a console.log inside handleCalRangeChange.

Fix mask-zero visibility (MEDIUM): In Dashboard.jsx where LayerControlAdvanced is rendered, only pass isSigned=true when overlayMeta.globalMin < 0 && overlayMeta.globalMax > 0. Currently it appears unsigned overlays (polar angle 0-180) receive isSigned=true.

Verify asymmetric double-click swap manually: handler may not be wiring properly or hit-test may need adjustment. Confirm onDoubleClickSlice fires by adding a temporary console.log in NiivueViewer's dblclick path.
critical_code_review_comments: LayerControlAdvanced.jsx ThresholdValue commit path: parseFloat(text) → onCommit(n); ensure onCommit closure has access to fresh sortedLo/sortedHi. Risk of stale closure since handleHiText is defined inline inside render with current sortedLo. Wrap in useCallback or recompute from props inside the handler.
Dashboard.jsx — isSigned should be computed as `(meta.globalMin < 0 && meta.globalMax > 0)` not just based on overlay presence.

ColorBarStack auto-thinning formula `widthPx = max(18, min(48, 72 - n*6))` works fine for 1-2 bars but at n=9+ produces minimum 18px which may still feel crowded; consider stacking vertically if count exceeds threshold.
Niivue instance still not exposed on window — limits automated introspection. Consider window.__nv = nv in dev build for testability.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Major batch of 6 features tested. Real Benson atlas (PASS) localization is the highlight — occipital-cortex-only as expected. Asymmetric layout (PASS) with axial-large-right works. Vertical colorbars (PASS) render correctly with auto-thinning. Clip plane (PASS) no purple slab. Reset-to-MNI (PASS). Two bugs remain: click-to-edit threshold commit fails, and mask-zero toggle shows for unsigned data. Re-test after main agent fixes these two. To test signed activation upload, generate a z-stat file with negative+positive values (e.g. nibabel.Nifti1Image of randn(64,64,64)).
